local H=game:GetService("HttpService") local G=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.GameConfig) local function verifyBothFaceText(part,title)
 assert(part and part:IsA('BasePart') and part.Transparency<1,'text sign missing or hidden')
 for _,face in ipairs({Enum.NormalId.Front,Enum.NormalId.Back}) do
  local found=false
  for _,surface in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
   if surface:IsA('SurfaceGui') and surface.Face==face and surface.Enabled then
    for _,label in ipairs(surface:GetDescendants()) do if label:IsA('TextLabel') and label.Visible and label.TextTransparency<1 and string.find(string.upper(label.Text),string.upper(title),1,true) then found=true end end
   end
  end
  assert(found,'visible sign text missing on '..tostring(face)..': '..title)
 end
 return true
end
local function verifyPremiumDisplays(root,G)
 local city=root.Polish['City Decor'] local count=0 local tiers={}
 assert(#G.PremiumFists>0,'empty premium catalog')
 for _,item in ipairs(G.PremiumFists) do
  local stand=assert(root.Interactables:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Stand'),'configured stand missing '..item.name)
  assert(stand:IsA('BasePart') and stand.Anchored and stand.CanQuery and stand:GetAttribute('PremiumOnly')==true,'stand is not an actual premium interaction')
  local display=assert(city:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Creator Store Display'),'showcase missing '..item.name)
  local visible=0 for _,d in ipairs(display:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA('BasePart') and d.Transparency<1 then visible+=1 end end
  assert(visible>0 and display:GetAttribute('VisualRole')=='PremiumFistShowcase' and display:GetAttribute('PremiumTier')==item.tier,'showcase geometry/tier missing')
  verifyBothFaceText(city:FindFirstChild(item.name..' Armory Nameplate'),item.displayName or item.name)
  assert(not tiers[item.tier],'duplicate premium tier') tiers[item.tier]=true count+=1
 end
 return count
end
 local root=workspace.PunchWallRPG local tier=root.Polish["Wall Tier Frames"] local parts,legacyWalls,ambient=0,0,0 for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("BasePart") then parts+=1 if d:GetAttribute("AmbientMotion")=="Pulse" then ambient+=1 end end end for _,w in ipairs(root.Walls:GetChildren()) do if w:IsA("BasePart") and w.Name~="Titan Server Wall" then legacyWalls+=1 end end local header=tier["Titan Containment Graphic Header"] local images,decals=0,0 for _,d in ipairs(header:GetDescendants()) do if d:IsA("ImageLabel") and d.Image=="rbxassetid://93552182756522" then images+=1 elseif d:IsA("Decal") and d.Texture=="rbxassetid://93552182756522" then decals+=1 end end local plates=verifyPremiumDisplays(root,G) local faces=true local presentation=root.Polish:FindFirstChild("World Presentation") local presentationReady=presentation and presentation:GetAttribute("ContractValidated")==true and (presentation:GetAttribute("DecorativePartCount") or 0)>0 and (presentation:GetAttribute("DecorativePartCount") or 0)<=(presentation:GetAttribute("DecorativePartBudget") or 0) assert(plates==#G.PremiumFists and plates>0,"premium display count mismatch") return H:JSONEncode({parts=parts,legacyWalls=legacyWalls,blocks=#root["Depth Blocks"]:GetChildren(),depthContract=root:GetAttribute("DepthBlockContractValidated"),landmarks=#root["Depth Tier Landmarks"]:GetChildren(),presentationReady=presentationReady,bossDepth=tier["Titan HQ Deep Tower Core"].Size.Z,ribs=(tier:FindFirstChild("Titan HQ Structural Rib -1") and tier:FindFirstChild("Titan HQ Structural Rib 1")) and 2 or 0,images=images,decals=decals,plates=plates,faces=faces,ambientReady=ambient>=6})

local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local RunService=game:GetService('RunService')
local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD
local part=workspace.PunchWallRPG.Polish['Wall Tier Frames']['Titan Warning Beacon -1']
local remote=game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest
local settingsValue=p.RPGStats.SettingsJSON
-- BEGIN AMBIENT WINDOW ASSERTIONS
local function observeAmbientWindow(part,duration)
 assert(duration==2.7,'ambient observation must cover the full 2.7 second window')
 local started=os.clock()
 local first,last,minimum,maximum,count=nil,nil,math.huge,-math.huge,0
 local done,failure=false,nil
 local connection=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
  if done or failure then return end
  if not part.Parent then failure='ambient part removed during observation' return end
  local value=part.Transparency
  if value~=value or value<0 or value>1 then failure='invalid actual transparency' return end
  local now=os.clock()
  first=first or now last=now count+=1
  minimum=math.min(minimum,value) maximum=math.max(maximum,value)
  -- Continue through the entire cycle even after a sufficient delta appears.
  done=last-first>=duration
 end)
 local ok,reason=pcall(function()
  while not done and not failure and os.clock()-started<duration+2 do task.wait(.02) end
 end)
 connection:Disconnect()
 assert(ok,tostring(reason))
 assert(not failure,failure)
 assert(done and count>=3 and last-first>=duration,'full RenderStepped ambient observation timed out')
 return {minimum=minimum,maximum=maximum,delta=maximum-minimum,samples=count,elapsed=last-first}
end
local function evaluateAmbientWindows(normal,reduced,inactive)
 assert(normal.elapsed>=2.7 and reduced.elapsed>=2.7 and normal.samples>=3 and reduced.samples>=3,'incomplete ambient observation')
 return {changed=normal.delta>.015,stable=reduced.delta<.002,base=math.max(math.abs(reduced.minimum),math.abs(reduced.maximum))<.002,inactive=inactive,normal=normal,reduced=reduced}
end
-- END AMBIENT WINDOW ASSERTIONS
local function settledSettings(expected)
 local ok,value=pcall(function() return H:JSONDecode(settingsValue.Value) end)
 return ok and type(value)=='table' and value.motion==expected.motion and value.sound==expected.sound
  and math.abs((tonumber(value.uiScale) or -1)-expected.uiScale)<.00001
  and g:GetAttribute('AmbientMotionActive')==expected.motion
end
local function awaitSettings(expected)
 local deadline=os.clock()+4
 repeat task.wait(.05) until settledSettings(expected) or os.clock()>=deadline
 assert(settledSettings(expected),'replicated settings and ambient state did not settle')
end
local originalRaw=settingsValue.Value
local original=H:JSONDecode(originalRaw)
assert(type(original)=='table' and type(original.motion)=='boolean' and type(original.sound)=='boolean' and type(original.uiScale)=='number' and original.uiScale>=.8 and original.uiScale<=1.2,'invalid original ambient settings')
g:SetAttribute('Iteration05AmbientOriginalSettings',originalRaw)
local result={changed=false,stable=false,base=false,inactive=false}
local ok,reason=pcall(function()
 local normalSettings={motion=true,sound=original.sound,uiScale=original.uiScale}
 remote:FireServer({action='UpdateSettings',value=normalSettings})
 awaitSettings(normalSettings)
 local normal=observeAmbientWindow(part,2.7)
 local reducedSettings={motion=false,sound=original.sound,uiScale=original.uiScale}
 remote:FireServer({action='UpdateSettings',value=reducedSettings})
 awaitSettings(reducedSettings)
 local reduced=observeAmbientWindow(part,2.7)
 result=evaluateAmbientWindows(normal,reduced,g:GetAttribute('AmbientMotionActive')==false)
end)
-- Restore even when the observation or its assertions fail.
local restored,restoreError=pcall(function()
 remote:FireServer({action='UpdateSettings',value=original})
 awaitSettings(original)
end)
if restored then g:SetAttribute('Iteration05AmbientOriginalSettings',nil) end
result.observed=ok result.restored=restored
result.error=not ok and tostring(reason):sub(1,240) or ''
result.restoreError=not restored and tostring(restoreError):sub(1,240) or ''
return H:JSONEncode(result)

local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local g=p and p:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui') and p.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild('PunchWallHUD')
local raw=g and g:GetAttribute('Iteration05AmbientOriginalSettings')
if type(raw)~='string' then return {restored=true,needed=false} end
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local value=H:JSONDecode(raw)
assert(type(value)=='table' and type(value.motion)=='boolean' and type(value.sound)=='boolean' and type(value.uiScale)=='number' and value.uiScale>=.8 and value.uiScale<=1.2,'invalid saved ambient settings')
game.ReplicatedStorage.PunchWallEvents.ActionRequest:FireServer({action='UpdateSettings',value=value})
local deadline=os.clock()+4
local restored=false
repeat
 task.wait(.05)
 local current=H:JSONDecode(p.RPGStats.SettingsJSON.Value)
 restored=current.motion==value.motion and current.sound==value.sound and math.abs(current.uiScale-value.uiScale)<.00001 and g:GetAttribute('AmbientMotionActive')==value.motion
until restored or os.clock()>=deadline
assert(restored,'ambient failure cleanup did not restore settings')
g:SetAttribute('Iteration05AmbientOriginalSettings',nil)
return {restored=true,needed=true}
